```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": ["A", "B", "C"],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [120, 220, 320]
})

# Convert to narwhals and reshape from wide to long
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)
result = df.unpivot(index="id", variable_name="month", value_name="sales")

print(result.to_native())
```
